title: 6.1 Sol orchestration flow
description: When delegation is useful, a Sol 6.1 root assigns bounded work to a Luna explorer (top), Luna researcher (middle), and Sol 6.1 worker (bottom). Results return to Sol 6.1 for integration and verification. The dashed branch adds Astra independent review only when concrete risk or a verification gap warrants it. The lower bypass skips review. Both paths return to Sol 6.1 for final checks. Icons are original explanatory symbols, not official logos. This is a recommended workflow, not evidence of deployment.
disclaimer: Recommended workflow; on-demand agents; original explanatory symbols, not official model logos. See the adjacent README caption.
